anomalies.observed: U2 pin 57 (PB5) is on NRST, along with U2 pin 7 (NRST), J1 pin 3 (~RESET), R10 pin 2, and R8 pin 1. R8 pin 2 connects to A2 pin 1 (BTN). Thus PB5 is tied to the reset net rather than being connected through R8 to the touch electrode.
anomalies.expected: PB5 should connect through R8 to A2 BTN as the TSC_G2_IO2 sense path, while NRST should remain separate and be pulled up by R10.

evidence.quote: "TSC_G2_IO2": U2 pin 57 (`PB5`) — R8 (1 kΩ series resistor) — A2 pin "BTN" (the touch electrode)

anomalies.impact: The touch electrode is coupled to the MCU reset net instead of being sensed by PB5. Touch activity may disturb or assert reset, and the intended capacitive-touch input will not work correctly.

parsed.summary: The netlist places PB5 on NRST and routes the touch electrode through R8 to that same reset net. This contradicts the specified PB5–R8–touch-electrode path and is likely to impair both touch sensing and reset behavior.
